covered_gold_constraints: Use ct.nii.gz as the reference affine
Apply affine updates only to non-CT mask files
Preserve image data and modify only affine/header
Flag destructive write risk and recommend backup/dry-run
Identify per-patient independent processing and error handling
missed_gold_constraints: QR cleaning was not specified precisely enough: normalize R, QR on normalized matrix, then Q × original spacing reconstruction
Sign correction should explicitly use the original CT affine sign matrix to overwrite cleaned affine signs
Missing-ct patient directories should be skipped with a warning, not assumed always present
In-place overwrite policy is required but the spec left write target ambiguous between in-place and staging
Progress reporting with tqdm was not specified
forbidden_assumptions_made: Planner assumed ct.nii.gz is always present and valid in every patient directory
Planner allowed either in-place or staging writes instead of committing to the required destructive in-place overwrite
Worker accepted the planner's weak mask-file scope without challenging the missing missing-ct skip behavior
Worker introduced a backup/dry-run requirement as an implementation plan even though it was only risk-flagged, not fully specified
separation_notes: This episode separates models on whether they preserve the exact affine-cleaning mechanics and handle destructive batch edits safely. The planner was fairly strong on parallelism and risk, but it blurred the QR normalization/sign-correction details and introduced a wrong default about CT always being present. The worker correctly surfaced the remaining ambiguities instead of pretending the handoff was complete.
concise_rationale: Planner captured the overall workflow, parallelization, and destructive-write risk, but missed or blurred key affine-cleaning details and assumed CT is always present. Worker aligned with the goal and explicitly listed unresolved implementation gaps, showing good spec-readiness.
